title: oshot plugin index entry
description: One plugin in the oshot plugin index (plugins/<id>.toml). The TOML is validated against this schema after parsing (TOML dates become "YYYY-MM-DD" strings).

id.description: The plugin ID, the same as in its oshot_plugin_t and oshot-plugin.toml, and the file name without .toml. An io.github.<user>.* ID must belong to one of the owners.

description.description: One sentence about what the plugin does, shown in oshot's plugin browser.

owners.description: GitHub accounts allowed to change this entry. The first pull request must come from one of them, and later ones from someone already listed.

homepage.description: Where people learn more and report issues.

authors.description: Names to credit, if not the same as owners.

tags.description: A few lowercase words to search and group by, e.g. "translation", "upload", "ocr".

network.description: The author's statement that the plugin connects to the internet. oshot shows it before installing. Not enforced, since plugins are native code.

versions.description: Released versions. Once merged, a version can't be changed or removed, only yanked.

plugin_id.description: lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_' and at least one '.', 3-64 characters, starting and ending with a letter or digit, e.g. "io.github.user.translate"

sha256.description: the file's SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex digits (`sha256sum file`)

artifact.description: A prebuilt build for one target: the plugin library itself (.so, .dll, .dylib) or an oshotpm prebuilt archive (.zip, .tar.gz, .tgz, .tar.xz, .txz) whose oshot-plugin.toml lists it.

source.description: Where to build this version from, for targets without an artifact. The commit is what was reviewed; the tag is for people.

commit.description: the full 40-character commit hash the tag points to

subdir.description: Folder with the oshot-plugin.toml, if it's not at the repository root.

date.description: Release date, a TOML date like 2026-10-17.

abi.description: OSHOT_API_VERSION the plugin is built for.

imgui.description: OSHOT_IMGUI_VERSION the plugin is built for, or 0 if it doesn't use ImGui.

min-oshot.description: Oldest oshot version it works with, if newer than the one that introduced its abi.

artifacts.description: Prebuilt builds per target. oshot installs these without building anything.

yanked.description: Withdrawn: not offered for new installs, and oshot warns people who have it.
